model_versions.carbon_intensity: carbon.ts-equivalent simplified accounting, gate factors amcrax.environmental.lca.route_spec

provenance.hypothetical_warning: Every quantity under mode 'hypothetical_lca' is a HYPOTHETICAL life-cycle carbon price, not Singapore law.

assumptions: NH3 price scenarios are inputs (Cho Table 8 300-610 USD/t; others data/singapore.yaml)
reference CAPEX cho2026_itemised_v1 (at or above the independent published range)
stored Aspen activity 6.756 kg NH3 feed + 0.595 kg NH3 fuel per kg H2
H2-a.uncertainty: MC (n=5000) feed share p5-p95 0.694-0.802; feed is the largest item in 1.0000 of draws
H2-a.envelope: NH3 >= 115 USD/t keeps feed above half of LCOH (CAPEX x1); CAPEX multiplier below 7.24 (capital charge vs feed, 450 USD/t) or 4.70 (capital + fixed opex vs feed); at 300 USD/t these are 4.83 and 3.09; plant capacity above x0.039 of the stored feed
H2-a.reason: The share follows from assumed prices, so a threshold analysis is used: feed stays the largest item unless NH3 falls below the threshold price or CAPEX rises several-fold; every sourced NH3 price (lowest 300 USD/t) and every sourced CAPEX multiplier (0.41-1.5) lies clearly on the dominant side.

assumptions: benchmark 3.06 USD/kg NE Asia SMR incl. capex (Argus, production-cost marker, not a Singapore price)
plant-gate LCOH, no compression or delivery
H2-b.uncertainty: break-even 277-371 USD/t over CAPEX x0.41-1.5; grey MC P(LCOH < 3.06) = 0.0140
H2-b.envelope: against the NE Asia SMR marker and the Singapore willingness-to-pay figure; plant gate; CAPEX multiplier 0.41-1.5
H2-b.reason: Competitiveness with the SMR marker needs NH3 at or below about 320 USD/t (about 371 at the lowest sourced CAPEX, x0.41); every central sourced price (450-1000) is above, only the low ends of grey (300) and green 2050 (315) reach it. Affordability is necessary. Note: even central grey ammonia is not affordable enough, a finding against a reading that grey ammonia is competitive.

assumptions: direct NH3 CCGT activity and efficiency from results/research/lca (Ahmad-calibrated)
H2-c.uncertainty: break-even gate EF 0.81-1.33 kg/kg over CCGT efficiency and leakage; grey sourced range 2.0-4.6
H2-c.envelope: Singapore power against NG CCGT or the grid average, GWP100, sourced gate-factor ranges
H2-c.reason: Necessity reading: grey NH3 (lowest sourced 2.0) is above every break-even (max 1.33), so only low-carbon NH3 can cut power-sector emissions. Not sufficient: blue v1 (1.16, range 0.77-1.92) mostly fails; blue v2 (0.77) and green pass.

assumptions: self-firing NH3 heat, 5000 km, Singapore grid
H2-d.uncertainty: grey H2 CI 15.1-34.2 kg/kg, always above unabated SMR 10-12
H2-d.envelope: cracked H2 at the PSA outlet vs fossil H2 comparators, GWP100, sourced EF ranges
H2-d.reason: Break-even gate EF vs unabated SMR is 1.31-1.58; the lowest sourced grey value 2.0 is above, so low-carbon NH3 is necessary. Blue v1 central (1.16) is only just below and its range (0.77-1.92) straddles; against SMR+CCS (break-even 0.41-0.67) only green passes.

assumptions: Carbon Pricing Act 2018 text as at 23 Nov 2026 (rate 45 from 2026, threshold 25,000 tCO2e, direct emissions only)
single-site facility, no other emitters on site
H2-e_mode_A_actual_policy.uncertainty: N2O factor not sourced; the threshold needs about 5 % of the fuel nitrogen to leave as N2O (about 1500 ppmv), far above the 0.15 ppmv simulated for an NH3 turbine. EITE allowances and future amendments not read.
H2-e_mode_A_actual_policy.envelope: current Singapore law; any plant size for the ammonia-route question (upstream emissions are outside the Act at every size)
H2-e_mode_A_actual_policy.reason: The tax charges no upstream emission, so the carbon cost is the same (zero) for grey, blue and green NH3, while low-carbon NH3 raises LCOH (blue +0.272, green current +4.04 USD/kg). Low carbon intensity is not rewarded under actual policy. This follows from the statute, not from a model assumption.

H2-e_mode_B_hypothetical_conditional.conditional_on: HYPOTHETICAL life-cycle carbon price applied to the full CI of the hydrogen (not Singapore law)

reference_prices.eu_ets_status: secondary press report (GMK Center citing ICE, EUA Dec-2026 future EUR 90.2-90.5, 2-13 Nov 2026); context only, not Singapore law

assumptions: life-cycle price on the full CI (no such instrument exists in Singapore)
H2-e_mode_B_hypothetical_conditional.uncertainty: threshold ranges from CI ranges and a joint Monte Carlo with NH3 price ranges (thresholds.json)
H2-e_mode_B_hypothetical_conditional.envelope: conditional on the hypothetical price only
H2-e_mode_B_hypothetical_conditional.reason: Blue overtakes grey near 33 SGD/t centrally but the CI ranges give 12 to 605, straddling 45, 50-80 and the EU ETS level (127). Green at current prices needs 305 SGD/t (range 156-466) to beat grey and 747 to beat blue: above every reference price. Green 2030 needs 144. So the reward exists only for blue at moderate prices and is uncertain; green current ammonia is not cheapest at any reference price.

note: Proposed verdicts only; the orchestrator decides. Mode B evidence is conditional on a hypothetical price and cannot change a row about actual policy.
